name: Candlelight: The Best of Pink Floyd
description: A string quartet plays Pink Floyd's music by candlelight at Hilton Porto Gaia on 15 November at 20:30. Tickets from €17.50.
longDescription:
Candlelight concerts are live performances held in a space lit by candles. This one is a tribute concert: a string quartet plays the music of Pink Floyd. It has no affiliation with the band.

The planned programme includes Wish You Were Here, Comfortably Numb, Another Brick in the Wall, Time, Money, The Great Gig in the Sky, Us and Them and Shine On You Crazy Diamond. The concert lasts 60 minutes.

The concert is at Hilton Porto Gaia on Sunday 15 November 2026 at 20:30. Doors open 30 minutes before the start and close 5 minutes before it begins. Seats are given out on arrival, first come first served, based on your ticket type. It's open to ages 6 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult. The venue is wheelchair accessible. Tickets from €17.50.

longDescriptionPt:
Os concertos Candlelight são atuações ao vivo realizadas num espaço iluminado por velas. Este é um concerto de tributo: um quarteto de cordas toca a música dos Pink Floyd. Não tem afiliação com a banda.

O programa planeado inclui Wish You Were Here, Comfortably Numb, Another Brick in the Wall, Time, Money, The Great Gig in the Sky, Us and Them e Shine On You Crazy Diamond. O concerto dura 60 minutos.

O concerto é no Hilton Porto Gaia no domingo, 15 de novembro de 2026, às 20:30. As portas abrem 30 minutos antes do início e fecham 5 minutos antes de começar. Os lugares são atribuídos à chegada, por ordem de chegada, com base no tipo de bilhete. É aberto a maiores de 6 anos, e menores de 16 anos devem vir acompanhados por um adulto. O local é acessível a cadeiras de rodas. Bilhetes a partir de 17,50 €.
